#  11122 - Bachelor Thesis Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **11122 - module is no longer offered from SS 2022**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **Bachelor Thesis**  |  
|  Bachelor-Arbeit   |  
| Department:  |  Faculty 1 - Mathematics, Computer Science, Physics, Electrical Engineering and Information Technology   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Prof. Dr. rer. nat. habil. Seibold, Götz 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 1 semester  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  Every semester   |  
| Credits:  |  12   |  
| Learning Outcome:  | Students demonstrate their ability in academic paper writing and result presentation in writing and talking. In the framework of the double-bachelor programme in physics with the TU Poznan the students acquire skills and insights in bilateral research projects also as an exercise in self-development. Further the module intends to impart knowledge in literature search and academic research methods and to strengthen the students ability to participate in scientific discussions. Additionally the module supports social competences as the capability of teamwork and further competences as accurateness, endurance, and curiosity.  |  
| Contents:  | Writing of the bachelor thesis. Presentation of results in a scientific appropriate style.  |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | 
  * For students of examination and study regulations from 2008: All credit points from the basic study period (semester 1-4) and all credit points from the 2 semesters at the TU Poznan
  * For students of examination and study regulations from 2017: All modules from first 6 semesters (180 credit points).

 |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Research paper/essay / 360 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  | Literature from the scientific field of the bachelor thesis  |  
| Module Examination:  | Continuous Assessment (MCA)  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  | 
  * written bachelor thesis
  * oral presentation 

The final mark is obtained from the weighted average of written bachelor thesis (0.75) andoral presentation (0.25).  |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |  
| Limited Number of Participants:  | None  |  
| Part of the Study Programme:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Remarks:  | The bachelor thesis has to be written in English. The duration of writing the thesis is limited to 4 months.Mandatory module double-bachelor programme in physics with the TU Poznan.  |  
| Module Components:  | consultations, according to agreementoral presentation  |  
| Components to be offered in the Current Semester:  | 
  * no assignment

 |
